slides.title: A flagship for thinking
slides.body: Proposals, contracts, hard decisions — the work where being wrong is expensive.

slides.title: A cheap, fast model for sorting
slides.body: Tagging emails, summarising calls, reading invoices — thousands of times a month.

slides.title: Sorting 3,000 emails a month
slides.body: Same job. Same volume. Three bills.
slides.foot: Rough estimate, about 1,000 tokens per email.

slides.title: Use the AI that lives where your work is
slides.body: A model you have to leave your workflow to reach is a model you stop using by Thursday.

slides.title: Not the flagship
slides.body: Released 28 September. Within about 2 points of Opus 5.5 on coding tests, at half the price.

slides.title: Here the flagship earns it
slides.body: It writes the animation as code and renders the finished video. Designers call motion its biggest jump.

slides.title: A speech model, not a text one
slides.body: One that listens and talks in a single step, instead of transcribing, thinking, then speaking.

slides.title: Mix them
slides.body: Nobody picks one model. You build a chain.
